Changed the experimental ANN branch in [src/db.rs](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/src/db.rs:40) to add `VDB_COARSE_PRESCORE_MODE=residual`, so the compact shortlist can use centroid-relative residual dims instead of raw selected dims. I also wired `--coarse-prescore-mode` through the local/exact ANN harness in [measure_ann_search_only](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/measure_ann_search_only:69), [measure_ann_benchmark](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/measure_ann_benchmark:37), the sweep helpers, and documented the cycle in [campaign_journal.md](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/campaign_journal.md:426), [research_notes.md](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/research_notes.md:346), [strategy.md](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/strategy.md:10), and [cycle_049.json](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/recent_cycles/cycle_049.json:1).

Results: residual coarse is better than the parked raw coarse branch, but still not promotion-grade. Best local point was cluster-scope residual `32 / 2048` at about `4716.29 QPS`, `0.9367` recall; primary-scope residual `32 / 2048` hit about `4766.76`, `0.9333`. I did not pay the exact ANN gate because the local ceiling was already too low. The kept official state is valid: `build_project` succeeded, `run_correctness_test` passed at `1.0000`, and a fresh quick `run_benchmark` reached `12750.38 QPS`.

Current expectation is still roughly low-`12k` to low-`13k` quick on the default scored path and mid-`5k` exact on the kept flat ANN branch. The next best move is not another narrow coarse budget sweep; it is either a materially cheaper coarse selector or a stronger residual-aware shortlist stage, most likely shared secondary-residual codebooks or another routing layer that actually cuts scanned vectors before the `~400+ us` selector cost dominates.

- Added configurable secondary-cluster geometry to the Rust ANN path in `src/db.rs` via `VDB_SECONDARY_CLUSTERS`, while keeping the default `256 x 64` hierarchy unchanged. I wired the same knob through `measure_ann_search_only`, `measure_ann_benchmark`, `sweep_ann_search_only`, and `sweep_ann_benchmark` so future cycles can re-test `256 x N` layouts without editing Rust again.
- The first geometry revisit parked that direction again. ## Cycle 48

- Added a new local geometry knob to the Rust path and ANN harness, `VDB_SECONDARY_CLUSTERS`, and wired it through `measure_ann_search_only`, `measure_ann_benchmark`, `sweep_ann_search_only`, and `sweep_ann_benchmark`. The workspace can now rebuild the `256 x 64` hierarchy as `256 x N` without hand-editing Rust for each geometry sweep.
- Geometry alone still does not transfer. On primed local `300`-query sweeps at the live `14 / 138 / 384` point, moving to `96` or `128` secondary clusters cut scanned vectors/query from about `12.05k` to about `8.85k` and `7.17k`, but route time rose from about `189 us` to about `230 us` and `290 us`, recall fell to about `0.933` and `0.923`, and QPS fell to about `5482.71` and `4935.90`. Nearby `72/80/88` geometry checks at `138-152` probes stayed invalid too, topping out only around `0.949` recall.
- A follow-on deterministic farthest-first k-means seed looked locally promising but failed the real gate. With that seed, primed local search-only at `14 / 136 / 320` reached about `6835.51 QPS`, `0.9510` recall, but the exact fast `1000`-query ANN benchmark reached only about `4783.53 QPS`, `0.9534` and first-search build time increased from the old roughly `4.2 s` band to about `11.3 s`. The seed change was reverted.
- The kept lesson is narrower and useful: future geometry work should reuse the new `--secondary-clusters` harness knob, but only behind a stronger routing/training change. Finer partitions by themselves reduce scan count, yet the recall curve and route cost remain worse than the flat `64`-secondary baseline on this host.
